results.question: average agreed price of completed bike sales in 2025

results.question: for each category, how many days on average does it take an item to sell?
results.sql:
SELECT la.category,
       ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM d.completed_at - la.listed_at) / 86400), 2) AS avg_days_to_sell
FROM nlq.deals d
JOIN nlq.listings_all la ON la.item_id = d.item_id
JOIN nlq.calendar c ON c.day = d.completed_on
WHERE d.deal_type = 'sale'
  AND d.status = 'completed'
  AND la.is_for_sale = true
GROUP BY la.category
ORDER BY la.category;
results.answer: The average days to sell vary by category: bikes_transport (11.20), clothing (11.32), dorm_essentials (11.39), electronics (11.40), furniture (11.61), kitchen (11.49), other (12.08), sports_outdoors (11.56), textbooks (11.56).

results.question: what share of conversations led to a request, by meetup spot?
results.sql:
SELECT ms.name AS meetup_spot, COUNT(*) AS total_conversations, SUM(CASE WHEN cv.led_to_request THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS led_to_request_count,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cv.led_to_request THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS share_percent
FROM nlq.conversations cv
JOIN nlq.listings_all la ON cv.item_id = la.item_id
JOIN nlq.meetup_spots ms ON la.spot_id = ms.spot_id
GROUP BY ms.name
ORDER BY ms.name;
results.answer: There are 7 meetup spots with conversations leading to requests. Curry Student Center has the highest share at 61.45%, followed by Marino Recreation Center at 63.61%.
